command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: backup =="
sudo -n cp -a /etc/default/grub /etc/default/grub.bak.$(date +%s)
sudo -n cp -a /boot/grub2/grub.cfg /boot/grub2/grub.cfg.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "== STEP 2: update /etc/default/grub =="
if grep -q 'audit=1' /etc/default/grub; then
  echo "already present in /etc/default/grub"
else
  sudo -n sed -i 's/^\(GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="[^"]*\)"/\1 audit=1"/' /etc/default/grub
fi
grep GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX /etc/default/grub

echo "== STEP 3: apply via grubby to all kernel entries =="
sudo -n /sbin/grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"

echo "== STEP 4: regenerate grub.cfg from /etc/default/grub for consistency =="
sudo -n grub2-mkconfig -o /etc/grub2.cfg

echo "== STEP 5: verify all boot entries contain audit=1 =="
sudo -n /sbin/grubby --info=ALL | grep -E '^(kernel|args)='

echo "== STEP 6: verify grub.cfg linux lines contain audit=1 =="
grep -c 'audit=1' /boot/grub2/grub.cfg || true
grep '^\s*linux' /boot/grub2/grub.cfg | sed 's/^/  /'

echo "== STEP 7: check default entry =="
sudo -n /sbin/grubby --default-kernel
sudo -n /sbin/grubby --default-args
